test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that substitutes the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.

Vicky and Deepa (tries their level best) to run from the ritual.
solution:
The correct answer is '**try their level best**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate substitution for the bracketed word segment '**(tries their level best)**' is '**try their level best**' .
 
• **Subject-verb agreement rule**- Singular nouns go with singular verbs while plural nouns go with plural verbs and in this case "Vicky and Deepa" together made the subject plural so plural form of verb will be used i.e** try their level best **.
 
 
• E.g. *We say, She **looks **very pretty and not She **look **very pretty.*
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** substitute is '**try their level best**'.
